milestones.desc: A separate price list from HQ

milestones.title: First 60 stores
milestones.desc: He Jiawen led setup and training

components.text: My part was the proposal and the pricing. Setup, training and upkeep were the team's.

notes: We started the year with no carrier business at all. I did two things: wrote the proposal, and got HQ to give the carrier channel its own price list, which took more than a month. Once we had it, He Jiawen and the team did the setup, the store staff training and the weekly incentive payouts.
